quests.name: Little Pamela
quests.text: Find Pamela Redpath.

quests.name: Pamela's Doll
quests.text: Find Pamela's doll.

quests.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
quests.text: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: Sister Pamela
quests.text: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.

quests.name: Zaeldarr the Outcast
quests.text: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Augustus' Receipt Book
quests.text: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.

quests.name: Auntie Marlene
quests.text: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

quests.name: A Strange Historian
quests.text: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

quests.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
quests.text: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: Brother Carlin
quests.text: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Uncle Carlin
quests.text: Find Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: Demon Dogs
quests.text: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

quests.name: Blood Tinged Skies
quests.text: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

quests.name: Carrion Grubbage
quests.text: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

quests.name: Redemption
quests.text: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
quests.text: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Villains of Darrowshire
quests.text: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Of Forgotten Memories
quests.text: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
quests.text: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Stormwind's High Order
quests.text: Speak with Saera Wirraway in Stormwind in The Park.

quests.name: Orgrimmar's Windshapers
quests.text: Speak with Corswyn Aseril in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
quests.text: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

quests.name: Of Lost Honor
quests.text: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.text: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

quests.name: Tormented By the Past
quests.text: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.

quests.name: To Kill With Purpose
quests.text: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.

quests.name: That's Asking A Lot
quests.text: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.  You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

quests.name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
quests.text: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.  Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork.  By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.

quests.name: Un-Life's Little Annoyances
quests.text: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

quests.name: A Wee Bit O' Necromancy
quests.text: Obtain a Necrotic Runestone from Maleki the Pallid in Stratholme, then find the Rotting Dwarf Corpse near the Undercroft in southwestern Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Keeper's Call
quests.text: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Letter from the Front
quests.text: Take the Torn Letter to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Note from the Front
quests.text: Take the Careworn Note to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Page from the Front
quests.text: Take the Ragged Page to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Envelope from the Front
quests.text: Take the Bloodstained Envelope to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Missive from the Front
quests.text: Take the Crumpled Missive to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Document from the Front
quests.text: Take the Smudged Document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
quests.text: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Return to Chromie
quests.text: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.

quests.name: Hidden Treasures
quests.text: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.

quests.name: Shadows of Doom
quests.text: Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Under the Shadow
quests.text: Check your map to find an area under Scourge attack. Go there and damage a necropolis by defeating the Scourge around them. Return 10 of their Necrotic Runes to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Hameya's Plea
quests.text: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

quests.name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
quests.text: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.  You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

quests.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
quests.text: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

quests.name: The Argent Hold
quests.text: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.text: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

quests.name: Mantles of the Dawn
quests.text: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
quests.text: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Battle of Darrowshire
quests.text: Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square.  Prevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus.  Prevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears.  Defeat Redpath the Corrupted.  Speak with the spirit of Joseph Redpath when he appears at the town square, then speak with Pamela at her home.

quests.name: Cryptstalker Armor Doesn't Make Itself...
quests.text: Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Crypt Fiend Parts.

quests.name: Bonescythe Digs
quests.text: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Bone Fragments.

quests.name: The Elemental Equation
quests.text: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.

quests.name: Binding the Dreadnaught

quests.name: Savage Flora
quests.text: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Savage Fronds.

quests.name: They Call Me "The Rooster"
quests.text: Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants an Argent Dawn Valor Token.

quests.name: Writ of Safe Passage
quests.text: Deliver the signed Writ of Safe Passage to Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Dense Weightstone

quests.text: Deliver 9 Wicked Leather Belts and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.text: Deliver 4 Runic Leather Pants and the Craftsman's Writ - Runic Leather Pants - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.text: Deliver 6 Brightcloth Pants and the Craftsman's Writ - Brightcloth Pants - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.text: Deliver 8 Runecloth Boots and the Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Boots - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.text: Deliver 15 Greater Arcane Protection Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.text: Deliver 20 Major Healing Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Major Healing Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Flask of Petrification
quests.text: Deliver 1 Flask of Petrification and the Craftsman's Writ - Flask of Petrification - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Stonescale Eel
quests.text: Deliver 40 Stonescale Eel and the Craftsman's Writ - Stonescale Eel - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.text: Deliver 30 Plated Armorfish and the Craftsman's Writ - Plated Armorfish - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Lightning Eel
quests.text: Deliver 30 Lightning Eel and the Craftsman's Writ - Lightning Eel - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Superior Armaments of Battle - Friend of the Dawn
quests.text: For 30 Insignias of the Dawn and 30 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Friend of the Dawn
quests.text: For 110 Insignias of the Dawn and 110 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.text: For 20 Insignias of the Dawn and 20 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
quests.text: For 27 Insignias of the Dawn and 27 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Establishing New Outposts
quests.text: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Bolstering Our Defenses
quests.text: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
quests.text: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.  It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.

quests.name: The Corpulent One
quests.text: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.

quests.name: The Call to Command
quests.text: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.

quests.name: The Crimson Courier
quests.text: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.  Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

quests.name: Nathanos' Ruse
quests.text: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

quests.name: Return to Nathanos
quests.text: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

quests.name: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria
quests.text: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

quests.name: The Eastern Plagues
quests.text: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.

quests.name: Order Must Be Restored
quests.text: Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.  Keep your wits about you, <Name>. The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
quests.text: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: In Search of Anthion
quests.text: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.

quests.name: In Search of Anthion
quests.text: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.

quests.name: Proof of Life
quests.text: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Anthion's Strange Request
quests.text: Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 Enchanted Leather, 3 Mooncloth and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Balance of Light and Shadow
quests.text: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task.  You may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.

objectives.text: The Balance of Light and Shadow

quests.name: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
quests.text: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.

quests.name: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
quests.text: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 2 Arcane Crystals, 1 Nexus Crystal and 30 gold pieces. You must also be Revered with the Argent Dawn.

quests.name: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
quests.text: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.

quests.name: The Ice Guard
quests.text: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 10 Insignia of the Crusade and 30 gold.

quests.name: The Shadow Guard
quests.text: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 10 Insignia of the Crusade and 30 gold.
